systemtray/main.qml.replace:
import QtQuick
import org.kde.ksvg as KSvg

id: activeModel
        sortRoleName: "effectiveStatus"
        sortOrder: Qt.AscendingOrder
        sortColumn: root.xpTrayAvailable && !root.vertical ? 0 : -1

id: tasksGrid
                Layout.row: 0
                Layout.column: !root.vertical && root.xpTrayAvailable ? 1 : 0
                // With no expander, reserve the theme's left cap ourselves.
                Layout.leftMargin: root.xpTrayAvailable && !root.vertical && !expander.visible
                    ? xpTrayBackground.margins.left : 0

id: expander
                Layout.row: root.vertical ? 1 : 0
                Layout.column: root.vertical || root.xpTrayAvailable ? 0 : 1
readonly property int smallIconSize: root.xpTrayAvailable ? 16 : Kirigami.Units.iconSizes.smallMedium
readonly property int cellSpacing: root.xpTrayAvailable ? 2 : Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing

digitalclock/main.qml.replace:
import QtQuick
import org.kde.ksvg as KSvg

systemtray/items/AbstractItem.qml.replace:
effectiveStatus: model.effectiveStatus === PlasmaCore.Types.PassiveStatus && root.xpRevealHidden(itemId)
        ? PlasmaCore.Types.ActiveStatus : (model.effectiveStatus || PlasmaCore.Types.UnknownStatus)
